title: Has The U.S. Flipped The Script
section_path: Has The U.S. Flipped The Script
section_path_text: Has The U.S. Flipped The Script
summary:
Iranian flows are halted, while other oil is trickling through
According to both the US and Iran, the warring parties are inching closer towards an agreement on a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU). The MoU will set the terms of a more permanent ceasefire between the belligerents. It has been reported that this would be for an initial 60-day period in which the Strait of Hormuz (SoH) would be reopened without restrictions, the US blockade will be removed, and Iran would be able to export oil.
